section.title: Push
section.p: Pushes local repository commits to the remote repository.

dlentry.dd: Git Staging view toolbar, Ellipsis menu, and Git menu.
The current branch in the selected working copy.
Local commits become available in the remote repository. If the local branch does not have a corresponding remote branch, a remote branch with the same name is created automatically.

section.title: Pull
section.p: Opens a submenu with actions for bringing changes from the remote repository into the local repository.

dlentry.dd: Pull drop-down menu in the Git Staging view toolbar and the Git menu.
The current branch in the selected working copy.
The pull action that you use from the drop-down menu becomes the default action of the toolbar button.

section.title: Pull (Merge)
section.p: Pulls the latest changes from the remote repository and merges them into the local branch.

dlentry.dd: Pull drop-down menu, Ellipsis menu, and Git menu.
The current branch and its tracked remote branch.
If both branches have new commits, Git creates a merge commit.

section.title: Pull (Rebase)
section.p: Pulls the latest changes from the remote repository, then reapplies local unpublished commits on top of the updated branch.

dlentry.dd: Pull drop-down menu, Ellipsis menu, and Git menu.
The current branch and its tracked remote branch.
Use rebase only when your team workflow allows it for unpublished local commits.

section.title: Pull...
section.p: Pulls changes from a remote branch other than the one being tracked.

dlentry.dd: Ellipsis menu and Git menu.
The selected remote branch and the current local branch.
A dialog box lets you choose the remote branch and the pull strategy: merge or rebase.

section.title: Resolve Using Mine
section.p: Resolves a conflicted file by keeping the local version.

dlentry.dd: Contextual menu of a conflicted file in the Unstaged files area.
The selected conflicted file.
This action discards the incoming version for the selected file.

section.title: Resolve Using Theirs
section.p: Resolves a conflicted file by keeping the incoming version.

dlentry.dd: Contextual menu of a conflicted file in the Unstaged files area.
The selected conflicted file.
This action discards the local version for the selected file.

section.title: Mark as Resolved
section.p: Marks a conflicted file as resolved after you edit the file and choose which changes to keep.

dlentry.dd: Contextual menu of a conflicted file in the Unstaged files area.
The selected conflicted file.
Use this action only after you check the merged file content.

section.title: Abort Merge
section.p: Stops the current merge operation and restores the repository to its state before the merge started.

dlentry.dd: Conflict resolution controls shown during a merge conflict.
The current repository merge operation.

section.title: Continue Rebase
section.p: Continues the current rebase after conflicts are resolved.

dlentry.dd: Conflict resolution controls shown during a rebase conflict.
The current repository rebase operation.

section.title: Abort Rebase
section.p: Stops the current rebase operation and restores the repository to its state before the rebase started.

dlentry.dd: Conflict resolution controls shown during a rebase conflict.
The current repository rebase operation.
